serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
You: She left, man! Aren’t you gonna go after her?
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceAngry(instant)
Ecclesiasticalot FF: No I’m not! It’s not a romantic comedy! 
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It’s for the best…
It doesn’t sound like he is so sure with this statement…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You should get going too. I hope I answered all of your questions.
You: Not really, but if I ask them you might break again so…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: … Fair enough.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Farewell boy, God be with you.
You: Yeah, bye!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
